## Clarifications

Q: What is in this public kernel?
A: The five Board skills above, plus the PUBLIC writing and sample-flow skills listed in the soul roster.

Q: Should stock speckit files be edited here?
A: No. Treat upstream speckit as read-only. Changes go upstream.

Q: Where do operator Lane skills live?
A: Not in this kernel. Do not copy private operator paths into a public export.

## Notes

- Do not document private org names, dual-purpose statements, or internal log filenames in this file.
- New Board titles or scaffolds are a constitution conversation, not an export add-on.
